_doc: How regular enemies move on screen (scripts/run/enemy_system.gd, render path only: no gameplay effect). Times in seconds, sizes in world pixels, squash / stretch / grow as fractions of the sprite's size. 'types' overrides any 'hop' / 'fly' number per enemy id. 'cycles_per_hop': walk-cycle loops per hop for sheets with a multi-frame walk (the legs step with the hop, so they speed up with the walker and stop when it stands). 'reduced' multiplies squash, stretch, lean and shake when Settings > Reduce effects is on. Bosses don't use this (their controller animates them).
